title: 12 Best "Shop for fresh flowers, olives, socca, and local produce at Nice's colorful Cours Saleya market."
description: Explore Nice's vibrant Cours Saleya market! Discover the best stalls for fresh flowers, local olives, authentic socca, and seasonal produce. Your guide to an unforgettable culinary and sensory experience in Vieux Nice.

places.name: Cours Saleya Flower Market (Marché aux Fleurs)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A beautiful bouquet of local flowers (e.g., roses, mimosa in season) or a unique handcrafted souvenir.

places.name: Cours Saleya Food Market (Marché Alimentaire)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A selection of Niçois olives, a block of local cheese (like chèvre or brebis), fresh focaccia, and sun-ripened tomatoes.

places.name: Chez Thérésa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A hot, fresh slice of Socca, eaten on the go.

places.name: Alziari
places.priceRange: From €10 ($11) for small bottles up to €50+ ($54+) for specialty oils
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A bottle of their 'Huile d'Olive Vierge Extra Goût Subtil' for a classic Niçois flavor, or a jar of their black olive tapenade.

places.name: Fenocchio Glacier
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Two scoops of something adventurous like lavender or rosemary, or a classic combination like fig and nougat.

places.name: Confiserie Florian - Vieux Nice
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A box of their signature candied violets or rose petals, or some regional fruit pâtes de fruits.

places.name: Lou Pilha Leva
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A hearty portion of Daube Niçoise (beef stew) with gnocchi, or a fresh slice of Pissaladière (onion tart).

places.name: Cresci
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A slice of their famous Pissaladière or a classic Margherita pizza.

places.name: L'Olivier du Cours Saleya
places.priceRange: From €5 ($5.50) for small jars, up to €25 ($27) for gift sets
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A selection of different marinated olives (e.g., Niçoise, Lucques), and a jar of green and black olive tapenade.

places.name: La Socca d'Or
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A warm, generously seasoned portion of socca, perhaps paired with a glass of local rosé.

places.name: La Cave de la Tour
places.priceRange: Bottles from €10 ($11) for local wines to €50+ ($54+) for premium selections
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A bottle of local rosé from Provence, or a bottle of Niçois Bellet wine to pair with your market-fresh produce.

places.name: Marché aux Poissons du Cours Saleya
places.priceRange: Fresh fish from €10-€30/kg ($11-$32/kg) depending on species
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A selection of fresh anchovies or sardines if in season, perfect for grilling or making local specialties.
